Report of Examination and Medical Opinion
Patient: Morgan Ashby-Vale
Date of Birth: 02/17/1981
Date of Service: 06/20/2025
Provider: Dr. Theodore Marchetti

Subject: Evaluation of Low Back Pain following Incident on 03/11/2025.

The examinee presented for a comprehensive evaluation regarding chronic low back pain.
The history provided indicates an injury sustained on 03/11/2025.
The patient reports pain primarily localized to the lumbar region.
Review of prior records from Lakeshore Imaging and Ridgeline Physical Therapy
was completed as part of this assessment.

Physical examination revealed mild tenderness in the lower back musculature.
Range of motion was slightly limited but within acceptable parameters for the
patient's reported complaints. Neurological testing was unremarkable.

The L4-L5 findings are degenerative and pre-existing, not causally related to the work incident of 03/11/2025.
The examinee is at maximum medical improvement as of today's examination.
No work restrictions are indicated.
No further treatment is medically necessary.

The overall clinical picture suggests that the current symptoms are consistent with
underlying degenerative changes rather than acute work-related injury.
The patient understands the limitations of their condition.

Signed:
Dr. Theodore Marchetti
